column7: Class guard for the cli module (own go.mod, so the root-module AST guard does not scan it): fails on any new os.Open / os.OpenFile (read) / os.ReadFile / ioutil.ReadFile in cli/ that does not go through cli/internal/regularfile, unless listed with a reason. It does not see reads behind a function value or via golang.org/x/sys/unix. PR #3186.
